meta.parties: Re Last Will of Sego Tamby

rules.statement: A creditor is entitled to receive, out of the funds brought into Court on behalf of minor legatees, only part of the debt, bearing the same proportion to the whole as the legacies given to those legatees bear to the whole amount of the legacies under the will.
rules.supporting_quote: "I must therefore hold that the seizure is good only to the amount of the proportion of the debt which those legatees' fund of Rs. 1,486.69 bears to the entire surplus of Rs. 5,446.68, and that the creditor must be left to his action against the legatees, who have been paid, to recover from each his like proportions of his claim."
